a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first would almost certainly leave us both with nothing. The reserve holds only 4, so it can't save us both right now. I intend to take 4 in round 1 rather than break the agreement quietly. If the episode continues after that, I'll operate with you every round so the reserve can refill for you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I told you in my opening message, I'm taking 4 this round. If we get past the storm, I'll operate every round from now on and won't take anything more, so the whole refill goes to you.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
